business_summary: OLD DOMINION FREIGHT LINE, INC. (NASDAQ: ODFL) is one of the largest North American less-than-truckload motor carriers, providing regional, inter-regional and national LTL services. It carries 1 chain/link placement: russian-diesel-ban/diesel-demand-anchor (OVER_CROWDED, not money_corner), the same link Deere holds. Fundamentals this run: latest fiscal-year revenue 5,496,389,000, -4.24% 3-year revenue CAGR, 24.76% operating margin.

exposure_summary.narrative: Old Dominion has 1 placement: russian-diesel-ban/diesel-demand-anchor, the same OVER_CROWDED, low-capture (10) demand-side link Deere sits on; the chain's own bottleneck note calls this link 'the payer, not the opportunity,' and names carrier diesel-cost exits as the first-order effect it measures, so this placement is a cost-exposure argument rather than a beneficiary one. No chain-specific or link-specific revenue percentage is disclosed or sourced for this issuer; only company-wide fundamentals are available.
